title: Why streaming was a big mistake...
description:
Remember when entertainment used to be affordable? Today, OTT platforms are charging premium prices for mediocre content, broken subscriptions, and endless ads—even after you pay! Want to watch one show? You need five apps. And each comes with its own monthly loot.

Meanwhile, piracy—though illegal—is becoming the “poor man’s Netflix,” offering everything in one place, for free. It’s not about theft anymore, it’s about frustration with a system that’s milking viewers dry.

In this video, we explore why so many Indians are turning back to piracy—and how OTT greed is driving them there.
